model.scope:
Price actual dynamic instruction traces with the repository's hwsim model.

Perfect caches, no memory/bus/SQ/DMA events and no final completion drain.
This is a synthetic CPU scheduling comparison, never hardware time or FPS.

value.limits: Actual core/IRQ/KOS counter instructions with synthetic state/register values. Includes fixture argument marshalling. No PMU-event generation, cache misses, bus or MMIO wait-state timing, complete gameplay frame, or console result is modelled.

pool.r0006:
Observe real opcode data accesses without inventing cache misses.

Instruction fetches are excluded; PC-relative literal loads are data loads.
The fixture maps cached RAM at low synthetic addresses, which become the
0x8c000000 alias only for the pipeline-model ELF. Distinct 32-byte lines are
working-set/touch counts, not measured fills or hardware bus transactions.
